---
name: Missing endpoint or capability
about: Ask for a Hetzner endpoint or feature this MCP does not cover yet
title: "[missing] <surface> <endpoint or capability>"
labels: enhancement, missing-endpoint
---

## What did you want to do
A clear description of the action you wanted the MCP to perform.

## Surface
Cloud, Storage Box, or Robot.

## Endpoint (if known)
Method and path, for example POST /servers/{id}/actions/attach_iso.

## Did the generic request tool work as a workaround
Yes or no. If yes, paste the call you used.

## Anything else
Links to the Hetzner docs for this endpoint help a lot.
